item.title: Ice-cold third quarter dooms Knicks, Cavs pull away
item.description: Cleveland outscored the Knicks 23-11 in the period, and held them to 3-for-24 from the field.

item.title: West Babylon fire at apartment complex displaces dozens of residents, officials say
item.description: One firefighter and two residents suffered injuries considered minor, a Suffolk County fire official said.

item.title: Hawks All-Star Jalen Johnson leaves win over Wizards with hip flexor injury
item.description: Atlanta Hawks All-Star forward Jalen Johnson left the game against the Washington Wizards with a left hip flexor injury.

item.title: Reneau's 23, Donaldson's 21 lift Miami over Florida State 83-73
item.description: Malik Reneau scored 23 points and grabbed 12 rebounds, Tre Donaldson had 21 points, six assists, and six rebounds, and Miami held on late to defeat Florida State, 83-73 on Tuesday night.

item.title: Trump honors National Guard members shot in Washington
item.description: President Donald Trump has presented the Purple Heart medal during his State of the Union Address and honored two National Guard members who were shot while patrolling in Washington last year.

item.title: Barrett scores career-high 28 points as Missouri beats No. 22 Tennessee 73-69
Derrick White scores 22, and a third-quarter blitz lifts the Celtics past the Suns 97-81
item.description: Derrick White scored 22 points, Neemias Queta had 14 points and 13 rebounds, and the Boston Celtics used a big third quarter to beat the Phoenix Suns 97-81.

item.title: Jefferson scores 21 and Momcilovic breaks ISU record for 3s as No. 4 Cyclones beat Utah 75-59
item.description: Joshua Jefferson scored 21 points, Milan Momcilovic made four 3-pointers to break the Iowa State record for 3s in a season, and the fourth-ranked Cyclones beat Utah 75-59.

item.title: Pack leads balanced Oklahoma attack in commanding 91-79 win over Auburn
item.description: Nijel Pack scored 22 points and Oklahoma used its first-half eruption to ride out a 91-79 win over Auburn.

item.title: Bradley, Burries and No. 2 Arizona outlast Baylor 87-80 to take 2-game Big 12 lead with 3 to play
item.description: Jaden Bradley scored 25 points, Brayden Burries had 24 and No. 2 Arizona outlasted Baylor 87-80.
